description: Search DataArt case studies by text query and/or tag IDs with pagination. Pass an empty query to browse all cases. Use get_case_tags to discover available tag IDs before filtering. Text and tags combine with AND. Multiple tags combine per tagMatch: "any" (default) or "all". Returns short records; use get_case with the id, slug or url of a result to get its full text.

pageSize.description: Items per page. Default is 20, maximum 50.

query.description: Text to search in title and description. Pass empty string to skip text filtering.

tagIds.description: Comma-separated tag IDs to filter by (e.g. "12,45"). Pass empty string to skip tag filtering.

tagMatch.description: "any" (default) - case has at least one of the tags; "all" - case has every tag.

name: search_cases
title: Search DataArt case studies
